name: Banh goi
summary: Bánh gối is a pillow-shaped fried pastry. One version is minced pork, black fungus, vermicelli, and a quail egg; another is pork, wood-ear mushrooms, and glass noodles.
origin: Hanoi, on two Vietnam Tourism street-food articles. The fillings they print are not the same.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article: minced pork, black fungus, vermicelli noodles, and a quail egg, eaten in the afternoon with the other fried snacks.
Vietnam Tourism’s street-food walk: pork, wood-ear mushrooms, and glass noodles, dipped in fish sauce and topped with mint.
seoDescription: Bánh gối in Hanoi is a fried pillow pastry. One Vietnam Tourism article adds a quail egg. Another names pork, wood ear, and glass noodles, with fish sauce and mint.
